_comment: Hand labels for the Northwind fixture vault (PASSPORT.md §14 P8.3), written with the notes. brief: task prompts and the notes a good brief must surface. links: [source, target] plain-text mentions that should become [[links]]. retarget: [ghost, note] near-miss ghosts that mean that note. entities: ghosts that deserve a note. Everything a suggester proposes outside these lists counts as a false positive. Known traps: 'teal stripe' in Brand voice is not the payment provider; [[Pricing v2]] is an older decision, not a typo of Pricing v3; `billing.dunning.v2` is code.
